title: Pandora's Cosmic Phoenix
description: A vibrant surreal painting shows a majestic cosmic phoenix with deep blue starry wings soaring across a night sky filled with comets and glowing orbs. In the foreground, a dark-skinned woman with long green braided hair and crescent moon adornments holds a glowing red-orange orb marked with symbols, while a banner reading 'PANDORA' is carried by a procession of shadowy skeletal figures amid ancient ruins and orange slices.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a giant cosmic phoenix with starry deep blue wings and fiery crest flying across a night sky filled with comets and glowing orbs. In the foreground a regal dark-skinned woman with long green braided hair and golden crescent moons holds a glowing red patterned orb. Below her a procession of shadowy skeletal figures carries a white banner that reads PANDORA. Ancient ruins, orange slices, and peacock patterns fill the scene under a swirling starry sky.
